claim_ceiling: One-qubit-message, one-qubit-black-hole, one-step Haar U(4) channel with a Petz recovery map. This is a finite-dimensional operational decoder-channel benchmark, not a macroscopic black hole, gravitational evaporation, QES/islands, or evidence that decoding is efficient in gate complexity.

register.unitary: seeded Haar U(4) on M tensor B
register.references: Q is maximally entangled with M before scrambling; R purifies the initially maximally mixed B

channel.definition: N_{M->A}(rho_M) = Tr_{Bprime}[(U_{MB} tensor I_R)(rho_M tensor Phi_BR)(Udagger tensor I_R)]
channel.channel_reference_state: sigma_A = N(pi_M) = 1/2 sum_bprime K_bprime K_bprime dagger
channel.petz_map: R_{pi,N}(rho_A) = pi_M^(1/2) Ndagger(sigma_A^(-1/2) rho_A sigma_A^(-1/2)) pi_M^(1/2)
channel.inverse_sqrt_method: 4x4 complex Hermitian Newton-Schulz iteration; no eigenvalue floor, support projection or silent PSD repair; nonconvergence is a typed failure

observables.primary: entanglement fidelity F_e = <Phi_QMhat| (id_Q tensor R o N)(Phi_QM) |Phi_QMhat>
observables.access: decoder input is A=E tensor R only; Bprime is a channel-environment label used to construct Kraus operators, never a runtime decoder input
observables.decoder_representation: two 2x4 Kraus matrices, defining a CPTP map A(4)->Mhat(2)
observables.complexity_boundary: No physical quantum circuit decomposition, gate count, circuit depth, runtime on quantum hardware, or implementation cost is claimed. The map assumes the exact scrambler/channel is known.

constant_output_baseline.decoder: ignore A and prepare I/2 on Mhat
constant_output_baseline.interpretation: input-independent qubit replacement channel; lower baseline, not a matched optimal decoder

independent_numpy_comparator.generator: NumPy PRNG; independently generated complex-Gaussian Haar U(4) via QR; channel Kraus construction; np.linalg.eigh inverse square root; direct Petz composition and entanglement fidelity
independent_numpy_comparator.caveat: Independent NumPy QR/eigensolver and PRNG path. These are not bit-for-bit ChaCha20 Rust results or Rust execution receipts.

test_plan: 32 Haar scramblers yield finite fidelity in [0,1], inverse-square-root residual and trace-preservation residual within tolerance
ensemble reports mean, standard error, min/max and numerical residual maxima
sample count below two is rejected
rust_implementation.status: five Rust tests authored; exact-head focused Rust runner pending

negative_controls: give the Petz decoder access to Bprime
give the Petz decoder hidden full-state amplitudes rather than A
omit the initial Bell(B,R) purification while retaining R as accessible side information
drop the 1/sqrt(2) factor in the channel Kraus operators
drop the pi_M^(1/2)=I/sqrt(2) factors from the Petz Kraus map
claim efficient quantum decoding from a two-Kraus representation without a circuit decomposition and gate/depth costs
replace the exact sigma_A inverse square root with eigenvalue clipping or silent regularization
compare entanglement fidelity against 1/2 rather than the input-independent qubit replacement baseline 1/4
